repair.title: Malaria Work Saved Millions
repair.summary: WHO estimates that global malaria efforts averted 2.3 billion cases and 14 million deaths since 2000.
repair.why_it_matters: Bed nets, testing, treatment, surveillance, and vaccines show that old diseases can still be pushed back.
repair.caveat: Malaria deaths rose in some recent periods, and funding gaps threaten further progress.
